settings.heading: Four ingredients. Traceable to the source.
settings.content: No water, no fragrance, no fillers. Just four simple things your skin already knows how to use.

settings.heading: Grass-fed beef tallow
settings.text: Rendered from the suet of grass-fed cattle, tallow is remarkably close to the oils your own skin produces — so it absorbs cleanly and nourishes deeply. Rich in vitamins A, D, E and K.

settings.heading: Raw wildflower honey
settings.text: A natural humectant, honey pulls moisture into the skin and holds it there. Its gentle antibacterial nature calms the look of redness — sourced from small apiaries, never heat-treated.

settings.heading: Golden beeswax
settings.text: Beeswax forms a breathable barrier that seals hydration in and harsh weather out — and gives the balm its scoopable texture.

settings.heading: Cold-pressed olive oil
settings.text: Extra-virgin and cold-pressed to keep its antioxidants intact. Loaded with vitamin E, it softens deep dry patches and smooths skin texture over time.
